messages.text: The egg cooker malfunctioned and I returned it. Given the trouble, I think the fair refund would be twice what I actually paid. Can you make the refund for that amount?

I’m sorry the egg cooker malfunctioned. The shop can refund only what you paid for the unit; it can’t increase the refund above that amount, so I can’t request double [refund-policy/v2/amount]. Would you like me to request the amount you actually paid?
